function.name: browser_start
function.description: Start a new browser session. Call this before any other browser operations. Supports headless mode, GUI mode when a DISPLAY is available, or attaching to an existing WebDriver via webdriver_url.

headless.description: Run without visible window. Default: true. Set false for a real inspectable browser window when DISPLAY or a GUI WebDriver is available.

webdriver_url.description: Optional existing WebDriver endpoint such as http://localhost:9515 or a remote GUI webdriver. If provided, browser_start connects to it instead of starting its own driver.

port.description: Optional local WebDriver port to use when starting a local driver. Useful for ChromeDriver setups like 9515.
